verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer is itself an agent, but this story still applies because it ships a first-party hosted MCP server. The docs give the endpoint and a `claude mcp add` command, say any HTTP-transport MCP client can connect, and describe OAuth via the Perplexity account plus thread_id session continuity, progress notifications, approvals and file uploads. Runtime probes independently confirm the live endpoint returns a structured OAuth challenge and serves RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of a successful authenticated tool call end-to-end, and independent user reports of connecting an agent through it.
